svg.title: A 50 km zone would cover 85% of Hawaii's land, and a 25 km zone 47%

cc:Work.dc:title: A 50 km zone would cover 85% of Hawaii's land, and a 25 km zone 47%
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of the main Hawaiian Islands with land shaded by zone: the 25 km zone covers 47% of the land, the 50 km zone 85%, and the 100 km zone all of it. The interior of the Big Island and parts of Maui fall outside 25 km.
